help.PosPage.title: Making a bill
help.PosPage.body: Search an item, or tap the mic and say "rice two kilos", or scan a barcode. Price and GST are worked out for you. Then pick Cash, UPI or Udhaar.
help.ItemsPage.title: Items
help.ItemsPage.body: Your items, prices and stock. Add an item, or open one to change its price or stock. Low stock shows in red.
help.BillsPage.title: Bills
help.BillsPage.body: All past bills. Open one to send it again, print it, cancel it or take items back.
help.CustomersPage.title: Customers
help.CustomersPage.body: Add customers and see what they owe (udhaar). Send a WhatsApp or SMS reminder to those who owe. Record payments when money comes in.
help.ReportsPage.title: Reports
help.ReportsPage.body: Today's sales, the cash / UPI / udhaar split, GST and best-selling items. Look at it once at the end of each day.
help.SettingsPage.title: Settings
help.SettingsPage.body: Shop details, UPI, PIN, staff, backup, printer and plan live here. Tap "How to use Angadi" to see the tour again.
help.ReceiptPage.title: Bill done
help.ReceiptPage.body: The bill is ready. Send it to the customer's WhatsApp, print it, or start a new bill. If WhatsApp isn't there, the share menu opens.
help.UpiPayPage.title: UPI payment
help.UpiPayPage.body: The customer scans this QR to pay. Tap "Payment received" only after you see the money in YOUR UPI app. Don't trust the screen on the customer's phone.
help.SplitPayPage.title: Split payment
help.SplitPayPage.body: Pay one bill with cash, UPI and udhaar together. Enter an amount for each; they must add up to the bill.
help.ReturnPage.title: Take items back
help.ReturnPage.body: Pick the items and quantity the customer returns. Stock goes back up and the refund (or the udhaar reduction) is recorded.
help.PrinterSettingsPage.title: Printer
help.PrinterSettingsPage.body: Switch on your Bluetooth printer, pair it in the phone settings, then pick it here and tap Test print. PDF bills work without a printer.
help.StaffPage.title: Staff & roles
help.StaffPage.body: Add managers and cashiers with their own PINs. You decide what cashiers may do (void, refund, collect dues). Activity shows who did what.
help.ChainPage.title: Chain & branches
help.ChainPage.body: For several shops: set the same chain code on every phone. A branch sends a report file and the owner's phone shows every branch's sales.
help.ExportPage.title: Export to Excel
help.ExportPage.body: Get sales, dues or the stock list as a file to send to your accountant. Opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
help.PayrollPage.title: Staff pay
help.PayrollPage.body: Add your workers, mark attendance daily and note advances. At month end open the pay slip and record the salary; advances are taken off automatically. Only the owner can pay salary.
help.ActivityPage.title: Activity
help.ActivityPage.body: See who did which important action and when (voids, refunds, salary…). Helps you spot problems at the counter.
help.ItemEditPage.title: Item details
help.ItemEditPage.body: Fill in the name, price (GST included), unit, GST %, barcode and low-stock level. Extra names (aliases) help voice billing recognise the item.
help.BillDetailPage.title: Bill details
help.BillDetailPage.body: See the items, total and payment. Send it again, print it, take items back, or cancel it (a reason is needed).
help.CustomerDetailPage.title: Customer details
help.CustomerDetailPage.body: Their bills, balance and payments. Send a reminder, record a payment, or set the date they promised to pay.
help.ShopSetupPage.title: Shop details
help.ShopSetupPage.body: Enter your shop name, phone and UPI ID. Scan your UPI QR or upload its photo so you can show it to customers. Add your GST number if you have one.
help.SubscriptionPage.title: Plan
help.SubscriptionPage.body: Free lets you make a limited number of bills a month. Pro makes bills unlimited. You pay through Google Play and can cancel there any time.
help.NotesPage.title: Feedback
help.NotesPage.body: Write a problem or idea. Tick "attach logs" so we can find the issue faster (phone numbers are never in the logs).
help.ShopsPage.title: My shops
help.ShopsPage.body: Each shop keeps its own items, bills and customers; nothing mixes. Add a new shop or switch here.
help.StockHubPage.title: Stock
help.StockHubPage.body: Suppliers, purchase bills, orders, expiry dates and the stock report: everything about stock coming in.
help.SuppliersPage.title: Suppliers
help.SuppliersPage.body: Keep the name, phone and GST number of the people who supply you. Purchase bills and orders use them.
help.PurchaseEditPage.title: Record a purchase
help.PurchaseEditPage.body: Enter the items, quantities and costs from the supplier's bill. Saving adds the stock. A saved purchase can't be edited; fix mistakes with a stock adjustment.
help.PurchasesPage.title: Purchases
help.PurchasesPage.body: Your supplier bills so far. Open one to see the details.
help.PurchaseDetailPage.title: Purchase details
help.PurchaseDetailPage.body: The items and costs of this purchase. It can't be changed; fix a mistake by adjusting that item's stock.
help.OrdersPage.title: Orders
help.OrdersPage.body: Orders to send to suppliers. Low-stock items fill the order for you; send it on WhatsApp.
help.OrderEditPage.title: Order
help.OrderEditPage.body: List what you need and how much. Mark it as sent. When the goods arrive, record the purchase from this order.
help.ExpiringPage.title: Expiry dates
help.ExpiringPage.body: Items near or past their expiry. Important for pharmacies. Expired items are blocked from billing.
help.StockReportPage.title: Stock report
help.StockReportPage.body: Total stock value and items running low or out. It also checks that the stock numbers add up.
walk.1.title: Making a bill
walk.1.body: On the first tab search an item, or tap the mic and say "rice two kilos", or scan a barcode. Price and GST are worked out for you. "Half a kilo" works too.
walk.2.title: Getting paid
walk.2.body: Choose Cash, UPI or Udhaar. For UPI show the QR, check the money in your own UPI app, then tap "Payment received". For udhaar pick the customer.
walk.3.title: Send the bill
walk.3.body: After the bill, send the PDF to the customer's WhatsApp, or print it on a Bluetooth printer.
walk.4.title: Items & stock
walk.4.body: On the Items tab change prices and stock. Low stock shows in red. When supplier goods arrive, record a Purchase.
walk.5.title: Customers & udhaar
walk.5.body: The Customers tab shows who owes what. Send a WhatsApp or SMS reminder. Record a payment when money comes in.
walk.6.title: Reports & backup
walk.6.body: Check Reports at the end of each day. Take a backup in Settings so your books survive a lost phone. Export to Excel is there too.
walk.7.title: Safety & staff
walk.7.body: Set a PIN in Settings. Give managers and cashiers their own PINs; important actions ask for the owner's PIN. Staff attendance and pay are there too.
walk.8.title: Plan & price
walk.8.body: Free: {0} bills a month. Pro: unlimited bills for ₹{1} a month or ₹{2} a year. You pay through Google Play and can cancel there any time. Your books stay on your phone.
